For this node, the highest-signal underfollowed search path is not just transformer manufacturers; it includes medium-voltage switchgear, electrical construction, substation contractors, power-control rooms, modular power, and behind-the-meter systems.

Future passes should search for US-listed or ADR suppliers of bushings, GOES/electrical steel, transformer components, cable/conduit, testing/inspection, relays/protection, and permitting/interconnection software; this pass found stronger evidence in switchgear and electrical contracting than in component-level public names.

summary: Expanded the universe around the AI data-center power-interconnection chokepoint with emphasis on underfollowed second-order public companies rather than hyperscalers or mega-cap electrical leaders. The cleanest discovery candidates are companies tied to medium-voltage switchgear, electrical contracting, transmission/distribution construction, and modular/mobile power systems. Powell Industries and IES Holdings have become more visible and now sit above the preferred small/mid-cap range, but their exposure is unusually direct. MYR Group remains a mid-cap grid-construction candidate with lower AI-labeling clarity. Pioneer Power Solutions is a micro-cap speculative shadow candidate because its product exposure is relevant but scale, backlog, and execution evidence are weak.
